# Aperture colour: HSL, colour balance, black & white, mixer, photo filter, split toning

- Kind: `editor`
- Category: `photo`
- Slug: `photo/color`

## Summary

The colour adjustment layers. HSL edits hue, saturation and lightness per colour range and has "Gray except this", which keeps one colour and turns the rest grey.

### "Gray except this" (keep one colour)
The HSL layer's ranges default to reds, yellows, greens, cyans, blues, magentas (centres 0, 60, 120, 180, 240, 300 degrees). "Gray except this" sets saturation -100 on every range but the chosen one and 0 on the kept one. The colour-pop looks (color-pop-red … color-pop-magenta) do the same as one click. A custom range (eyedropper) can target an exact hue.
Every adjustment layer also has opacity 0–1, blend normal/luminosity/color, enabled, an optional name and an optional mask. Percent-style values (-100 to 100) are 0 when unchanged.
